---
title: Front matter and metadata-files
metadata-files:
  - metadata-files-extra.yml
shared: document-value
custom:
  shared: document-value
  from-document: document-value
keywords:
  - document-keyword
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta name="keywords" content="document-keyword, metadata-file-keyword">'
          - '<div id="shared">\s*<p>document-value</p>'
          - '<div id="custom-shared">\s*<p>document-value</p>'
          - '<div id="custom-from-document">\s*<p>document-value</p>'
          - '<div id="custom-from-metadata-file">\s*<p>metadata-file-value</p>'
        - []
---

The document's front matter wins over its `metadata-files` for a value both define, and what only the metadata file defines is kept, including entries of a list and keys of a mapping the front matter also defines.

{{< meta shared >}}
